narrative.intro: Ameresco's federal contract activity in FY2027 to date shows $56.4M in obligations. The Department of Veterans Affairs is the buying agency that obligated $56.4M. Ameresco received 4 awards so far, with an average award size of $14.1M. Obligations fell 81.8% year over year. Fiscal-year comparisons show wide swings: FY22 obligations were $122M, FY23 obligations were $107M, FY24 obligations were $75.8M, FY25 obligations were $541M, and FY26 obligations were $309M. Current-year totals are partial and represent fiscal year to date activity. The available top-agency list names the National Archives and Records Administration with $0 in obligations. Use these figures to gauge where federal spending toward Ameresco sits this fiscal year versus prior years.
